title: Most new believers are being taught too much...
paragraphs: Most new believers are being taught too much...
And that's exactly why many stop growing.
Read that again.

They're overloaded with information...
But starving for foundations.

They learn debates before devotion.
Opinions before obedience.
Theology before intimacy with Christ.
And then they wonder why their faith feels weak.
WHAT SHOULD I TEACH NEW BELIEVERS FIRST?
This powerful discipleship guide reveals the FIRST truths every Christian must understand if they want to build a faith that lasts.
Because if the foundation is weak...
Everything built on top eventually cracks.
🔥 THIS BOOK WILL SHOW YOU:
✅ Why Jesus must be taught before anything else
✅ The Gospel truths every believer must understand deeply
✅ How to build a daily Bible and prayer habit
✅ The identity truths that defeat insecurity and confusion
✅ Why church community is essential for spiritual growth
✅ How to fight sin without living in constant defeat
✅ The discipleship roadmap every mature believer should know
Many Christians know a lot.
Few are actually growing.
Most collect information.
Few build transformation.
Most want spiritual maturity.
Few build spiritual foundations.
The difference changes everything.
It's part of a growing movement.
A movement of believers who refuse to stay spiritually shallow.
A movement of Christians who want biblical truth—not motivational fluff.
A movement focused on discipleship, repentance, obedience, faith, and transformation.
Inside you'll also unlock:
📚 Biblical discipleship resources
📚 Spiritual growth guides
📚 Prayer and faith-building books
📚 Identity in Christ resources
📚 New releases added regularly
This library keeps growing almost daily.
Not everyone will join.
Not everyone is hungry enough.
But if you're serious about becoming the believer God called you to be...
This is for you.
if you're committed to growing in Christ.
